gate: Most people mistake the drive of this code for stubbornness, or for a taste for conflict. It is neither. The pull here is toward a principle, and the principle is felt before it is articulated. When something is off, when an agreement has gone hollow, when the terms of a bond no longer match the truth between two people, this gate registers the misalignment as a physical refusal. The body says no before the mind has the words. What follows is the work of revolution at the small scale, the renegotiation or the parting. The code is built for the moment when continuing on the old terms becomes impossible. The misread, then, is to call it cold. It is the opposite. The rejection comes from caring enough about the bond to want it true, and refusing to let it survive on a lie.
centre_field: The emotional solar plexus is a tidal place, where feeling rises and falls in waves a person cannot rush. That placement is the whole teaching. The rejection coded here does not belong to the mind. It is processed through the wave, which means clarity arrives slowly and only after the feeling has passed all the way through. To act on this code at the peak of a wave is to break things one would rather have kept. To wait it out is to discover whether the no is the wave talking, or the principle. The centre is also a motor. It supplies the force, the heat behind the stand. So the teaching is double. The energy to make the cut is here, and the patience to know whether the cut is real is also here, and the two have to find each other.
channel: A circuit needs both ends. This code is one end, and on its own it can sense the misalignment but cannot say what to want instead. It reaches downward into the gate of wanting, the root-level pulse that knows what it is hungry for, and the two together form the channel of synthesis. Synthesis is the right word. Alone, rejection is only a no. Joined with wanting, it becomes a sorted yes, a new agreement made of what survived the refusal. The code lacks, on its own, the forward pull. It can clear a room and not know what to fill it with. The wanting supplies that. And the wanting, without this code, has no way to know which of its hungers are clean. So the two need each other to land. One sorts. One pulls.
